positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Build responsive front-end interfaces with modern frameworks and highly optimized back-end systems for 
performance and security 
▪ Utilize C#, React, C++, TypeScript, Node.js and SQL to develop and maintain a scalable web service, 
efficiently serving thousands of users with a suite of essential tools across the country 
▪ Develop and deploy scalable web applications in an Agile development environment, actively participating 
in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives 
▪ Collaborate cross-functionally daily with peers, designers, product owners, and customers across the 
country, to consistently ensure the delivery of high-quality products 
▪ Conduct code reviews, debugging, and testing to ensure robust and maintainable codebases 
▪ Seamlessly employ Appian (low-code/no-code platform) as a core tool in daily workflows, maximizing its 
capabilities to rapidly prototype solutions and drive organizational efficiency 
▪ Incorporate the integration of an existing system into a cloud-based infrastructure, dramatically optimizing 
accessibility , reliability, and scalability by ten times while ensuring a smooth transition.
positions.insights: Agile Application Development, React.js and +8 skills

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Thoroughly investigated and analyzed data dumps and system logs to precisely identify root causes of 
application crashes saving Yunex thousands every crash 
▪ Proactively collaborated with stakeholders to understand business and IT management processes, 
effectively translating requirements into technical solutions that aligned with organizational goals. 
▪ Efficiently resolved end-user technical issues through systematic troubleshooting, ensuring uninterrupted 
system functionality and high user satisfaction. 
▪ Partnered closely with product owners to redesign map and icon functionalities using C#, significantly 
enhancing UX and application performance. 
▪ Rapidly identified and resolved XAML rendering issues, optimizing UI responsiveness and delivering a 
seamless, visually consistent experience for end-users.
